title: Regulation of the Trp Operon: Repression and Attenuation
worked_numerical_reasoning_cases: RNA abundance after a step change
method: Saved HTML p.teaching-prose paragraphs counted by whitespace; excludes headings, tables, practice, answers, revision, citations, captions and SVG. Article text includes supplementary material including expandable answers but excludes SVG and buttons.

comparator.comparison: 13,622 words across 18 mechanism-focused theory sections; no exact duplicate paragraph. Comparable narrative depth with narrower topic.

scope_review: Merged CSIR–UGC–DBT NET page 4, separate CSIR NET page 3 and archived MP SET 2024 page 3 visually checked. Academy roadmap verified; TrpR, corepressor, trpEDCBA, trpL, tandem UGG codons, charged tRNA, coupled transcription/translation, 1:2, 2:3, 3:4, intrinsic termination, dual regulation, mutant prediction. Lac and global positive control bounded; detailed Trp biosynthesis excluded.
review_pass_1: Internal scientific review checked free vs charged Trp, allosteric dimer and operator, leader timing, G–U wobble qualification, intrinsic terminator, B. subtilis TRAP, conditional probability, limitations of equilibrium and kinetic models, evidence attribution and scope. Checked available standard textbook, review, PDB and primary paper abstracts/excerpts; hypothetical data distinguished from observations.
review_pass_2: Internal instructional review checked chronological progression, causal clarity, separate gates, illustrations and labels, balanced options, 50 explanations, revision. Strengthened 14 sets of distractors, shuffled answer positions, added schematic repressor SVG, captions and syllabus links.

arithmetic_checks.scope: charging, serial gate, ratio, binding, exponential folding, timing, RNA response, compensatory mutation and numeric questions

academic_self_review.method: Internal editorial judgement, not externally certified. Deductions for reliance on some source excerpts rather than full papers (science), room for richer mechanistic examples (depth), simplified hypothetical datasets (experimental), some straightforward distractors despite revision (practice), and lack of browser/device interaction testing (technical).

limitations: Internal author/editor review, not external peer review.
MP SET 2024 archived copy, not verified current official MPPSC-hosted syllabus.
Source records, abstracts and accessible excerpts checked, not all full primary articles.
Static HTML/SVG and arithmetic checks; browser/mobile/fullscreen and independent accessibility testing not performed.
